text:
jon_sales: Meridian Health signed the POC LOI. They want a capacity plan for a potential enterprise commit. Requirements: steady 500 rps embeddings (10h/day), occasional campaign spikes to 2.5k rps for ~60-120s, 95th gen latency target <300ms, SOC2 + HIPAA checks. Can we scope?

tara_se: I'll run traffic profile. Quick Q: mostly embeddings or mixed gen? Also what model?

jon_sales: Mostly embeddings (~80%) + short responses. They prefer a 3B-class open model but asked about quantized int8.

lee_eng: Recommend 7 reserved GPUs (A100/A10 mix) with 3 burst slots. Rationale: embeddings throughput ~900 rps/GPU for phi-1.8b-int8 in prod after warm cache; use 7 to give headroom plus autoscale. Autoscale policy draft: scale when moving avg rps_per_gpu > 0.75, add one burst slot per threshold, cooldown 60s, max burst 3.

mike_ops: Ops notes: spread across 3 AZs, preheat 20m before expected blasts using embedding seeds, KV cache TTL 30-60m. Warmup command provided in runbook. Also recommend monitoring: cache hit ratio, queue depth, 95/99 latency, GPU util.

zoe_security: Security asks: BYOK, audit logs export, retention policy, scoping PHI flow. Legal needs to countersign DPA before we share detailed architecture. Also note: they asked about on-prem connector for ingestion 3 if needed.

infra_bot: POC infra can be provisioned in us-east-1. Canary window: 2024-10-10T15:00:00Z.

tara_se: Action items: 1) Lee run 2-hour smoke (steady 500rps + two 2-min 2.5krps spikes) and post results, 2) Mike draft preheat runbook and cost estimate, 3) Zoe start questionnaire draft, 4) Jon coordinate legal/DPA.

lee_eng: Note: if mean chat length <30 tokens, we can probably drop to 6 reserved GPUs. Will test this in the smoke.

jon_sales: Thanks team 1 I'll consolidate the estimate for Meridian and loop in finance.
